label: City
view: taken at eye level from the middle of a street, looking straight down the street

label: Town
view: taken at eye level from the middle of its main street, looking straight down the street

label: Village
view: taken at eye level from the middle of its main road, looking straight down the road

label: Suburb
view: taken at eye level from the middle of a residential street, looking straight down the street

label: Rural area
view: taken at eye level, with the horizon straight across the middle of the frame

label: Farm

label: House
view: taken straight on from across the street at eye level, with the whole front of the house centered in the frame

label: Market
view: taken at eye level from the middle of a central aisle, looking straight down the aisle
